data.long_meaning: The name Fancy is derived from the Old French word ‘faince’ which means ‘to feign’ or ‘to make’. Over time, it came to mean ‘elegant’ or ‘luxurious’. In modern usage, Fancy refers to someone or something that is elegant, stylish, and impressive. The name Fancy carries the meaning “Elegant, Luxurious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Fancy usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, luxurious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
